page_title: EVE 0-1 WOL | Everton v Wolves 26/08/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' That's the end of the match.
90+6' Pablo Sarabia (Wolves) releases a promising shot from the free kick on the edge of the box. His effort towards the bottom left corner is comfortably saved by Jordan Pickford.
90+5' James Garner (Everton) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Craig Pawson signals. Wolves earn a free kick which could lead to a goal-scoring opportunity.
90+4' Pablo Sarabia (Wolves) goes on a weaving run through the defence and gets within shooting range but his effort is blocked.
90+2' Sean Dyche decides to make a substitution. Idrissa Gueye will be replaced by Michael Keane (Everton).
90+1' Substitution. Thomas Cannon (Everton) on for Arnaut Danjuma.
90' 5 additional min. will be played.
90' Chermiti (Everton) is shown a deserved yellow card for saying too much to the referee.
87' 0 - 1 Pedro Neto produces a beautiful lofted cross into the box, where Sasa Kalajdzic (Wolves) rises high to head the ball into the bottom left corner and beyond the goalkeeper. He makes it 0:1.
86' The ball rebounds off the defender into the path of Jarrad Branthwaite (Everton), who immediately strikes for goal from inside the box but sends it a whisker wide of the left post.
86' The referee signals a corner kick to Everton.
85' Here is a change. Hugo Bueno is going off and Gary O'Neil gives the last tactical orders to Toti (Wolves).
85' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Sasa Kalajdzic (Wolves) comes onto the pitch for Matheus Cunha.
83' Nathan Patterson (Everton) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Jose Sa intercepts the ball.
83' Total attempts – 14:8. The current number of shots on goal is 7:0.
80' The goal by Everton is DISALLOWED on the advice of the video assistant referee due to an offside.
79' The Everton players halt their celebrations as referee Craig Pawson makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was an offside in the build-up play.
78' Goal! Abdoulaye Doucoure (Everton) beats the goalkeeper with his effort.
74' A substitution has been made. Fabio Silva is replaced by Pablo Sarabia (Wolves).
73' Jose Sa steps in and intercepts a long pass from Nathan Patterson (Everton).
70' Ashley Young (Everton) steps up to take the corner, but the ball just sails in among the defenders.
68' Craig Dawson (Wolves) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Craig Pawson had an easy-decision to make.

67' What a save from Jose Sa! Abdoulaye Doucoure (Everton) jumps high to meet a cross and glances a promising header from close range towards the roof of the net, but the goalkeeper pulls off a brilliant save to keep it out.
67' The referee blows his whistle, Everton are awarded a corner kick.
66' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Chermiti (Everton) replaces Lewis Dobbin.
64' Arnaut Danjuma (Everton) receives a diagonal pass, bursts into the box and shoots towards the bottom left corner. Jose Sa is well positioned, though, and it's a comfortable save.
62' James Garner (Everton) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card.
61' The ball goes out of play and it will be a corner kick.
60' A sweet pass inside the box gives Fabio Silva (Wolves) time to measure a shot, but it's slightly mishit and goes just wide of the right post. That really was a great chance!
57' GOAL DISALLOWED! Controversy and anger as Fabio Silva (Wolves) has a goal ruled out, incredibly, for offside.
53' Jarrad Branthwaite (Everton) gets booked for the first time in this match.

53' CHANCE! James Garner (Everton) goes very close! He gathers a cross inside the box and fires a sublime shot towards the right side of the goal, but Jose Sa produces an excellent save. Superb goalkeeping! Jarrad Branthwaite (Everton) is given too much space inside the goalmouth and heads the ball towards underside of the crossbar, but the keeper shows his fast reflexes to keep the ball out.
53' Ashley Young (Everton) will deliver the corner kick.

52' Arnaut Danjuma (Everton) latches on to a lofted pass from the resulting set piece and pulls the trigger from around the penalty spot. His effort towards the left side of the goal is saved by the excellent Jose Sa. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Everton.
51' Craig Pawson shows a yellow card to Mario Lemina (Wolves) for his blatant foul.
49' Hugo Bueno (Wolves) plays in a hopeful cross, but it doesn't find its way to any of the attacking players. The ball goes out of play and Everton will have a goal kick.
48' Lewis Dobbin (Everton) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. The ball goes out of play and Wolves will have a goal kick.
46' There will be a change on the pitch for the second half. Gary O'Neil probably wasn't satisfied with the performance of Hee-Chan Hwang (Wolves). He is replaced by Rayan Ait Nouri.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+3' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45' There will be a minimum of 2 min. of added time.
43' Matheus Cunha (Wolves) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
40' Yellow card. Nelson Semedo (Wolves) goes into the book for a bad tackle on his opponent.
36' Arnaut Danjuma (Everton) smacks a great volley at goal from inside the box, but sends the effort just wide of the right post.
36' Pedro Neto (Wolves) receives a well-played pass inside the penalty area and shoots. He sends the ball into orbit.
33' 7:2 – the total goal attempt statistics. The number of shots on goal at present is 2:0.
30' Ashley Young swings in the free kick towards Jarrad Branthwaite (Everton), who powers a header well wide of the right post from close in.
29' Joao Gomes (Wolves) receives a yellow card for talking out of turn to the referee.

28' Lewis Dobbin (Everton) is strong enough to get to the ball and produces a header from close range. Even though it was aimed precisely towards the right side of the goal, Jose Sa didn't have a hard time stopping the attempt as it wasn't powerful enough. The defence just can't clear the ball and a rebound eventually falls to James Tarkowski (Everton) deep inside the box, but his well-hit shot flies just wide of the right post.
28' The corner is swung in but Everton can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
26' Hee-Chan Hwang (Wolves) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
25' Pedro Neto (Wolves) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger.
22' Hugo Bueno (Wolves) did his best to latch on to a crossfield pass, but it was too long and it goes out of play. The linesman signals a throw-in for Everton.
19' Everton fail to score from a corner as Jose Sa (Wolves) leaps to collect the ball.
19' The ball is cleared after Lewis Dobbin (Everton) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The ball goes out of play and Everton have been awarded a corner kick.

14' What a sweet touch by Arnaut Danjuma (Everton) as he runs onto a pass deep into the box and fires a fine shot to the right side of the net. The keeper makes a superb save and pushes the ball against the post.
13' Lewis Dobbin (Everton) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
11' Pedro Neto (Wolves) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
8' Nathan Patterson (Everton) clips a neat ball into the box in the direction of Arnaut Danjuma, but he can't get on the end of the pass. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Wolves.
8' Amadou Onana (Everton) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal.
7' What a miskick by Mario Lemina (Wolves). He smashes a volley from long distance that goes into the stands.
5' Arnaut Danjuma (Everton) receives a pass and decides to smash the ball from long range, but his poor effort sails high over the bar.

3' Mario Lemina (Wolves) latches on to a cross from the free kick and attempts to direct a bullet header into the right side of the goal. Jordan Pickford is alert, though, and makes a great save to deny him.
2' Craig Pawson blows the whistle, Idrissa Gueye (Everton) is penalised for a foul. Wolves earn a free kick.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
The players are out and the match is about to start. Wolves will have the kick-off.
Craig Pawson is the one to supervise the game today.
